name: Riso

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: uncoated stock. In Night the key plate becomes the page.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Cards, step cards, proofs: a whiter sheet laid on the paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells, code, inactive tracks, table stripes.

tokens.name: manila
tokens.usage: Luggage tags and folio stock: physical card, the same in both modes. Text on it is on-yellow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and quiet borders. The 2px key edge is the real border.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: The key plate: text, edges, hard shadows. Every other ink sits on top of it.

tokens.name: key-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, imprints, captions.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Ink 1. Primary actions, the first series, the headline colour.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on blue.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for blue tags and selected rows.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Ink 2. Fluorescent; the second series, the slipped plate behind a headline, badges.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text on pink.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for pink tags and info callouts.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Ink 3. Highlighter and ticker ground; never text, never a line.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text on yellow.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success text and the kept share, always with a word or a pip.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success callouts and positive tags.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings as text: a dark ochre on paper, the yellow itself at night.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning callouts.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Errors and the lost share. A printer’s red, not pink.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error callouts.

principles: Blue, pink and yellow over navy. There is no fourth ink; a new colour is a new plate, and you do not have one.
Inks multiply where they cross. Gradients and blur do not exist in a riso; the halftone dot does.
A headline is printed three times, each pass off by a hair. The slip is the signature; keep it under .05em.
Chapters open full-bleed in one ink with the number enormous. Cards are sheets with a hard shadow, slightly turned.
Facts live on luggage tags and folios: mono caps, a punched hole, a string. The reader picks them up.

type_roles.name: display-xl
type_roles.usage: One per page. The chapter word, the cover word. Soft, wonky, enormous.

type_roles.name: display-m
type_roles.usage: Tag titles, stat blocks, page titles.

type_roles.name: deck
type_roles.sample: In which a hundred things are laid out on one long bench.
type_roles.usage: The italic line under a headline, chapter subtitles, pull quotes.

type_roles.name: body-l
type_roles.sample: Every one will leave by one of three doors.
type_roles.usage: Step cards and lead paragraphs. Fraunces at 500 reads at length.

type_roles.name: body
